In approximately [[30,000 BBY]], members of the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which [[Homeworld/Legends|originated]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and had been transplanted offworld by the powerful beings known as the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]], launched an '''incursion''' of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] world [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The latter was home to the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] species, which had by that [[Time/Legends|time]] developed a pre-industrial society and members of which had mastered powerful [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|granted]] by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], specifically its [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] aspect. The Sith fought off the Killik incursion of their homeworld, and the Celestials and the Killiks both ultimately disappeared from the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] around that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The incursion of Korriban was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
